<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def timer_len():
    row=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[1]
    return sum(1 for ch in row if ch=='b')
def snapshot():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    d = set()
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        b=tuple((p[0],p[1]) for p in n['boundary'])
        # exclude timer (row1) and switch handles (row42,3px)
        if b[0][0]==1: continue
        if n['pixels']==3 and b[0][0]==42: continue
        d.add((n['color'],n['pixels'],b))
    return d
def sw_state():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    s = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==3 and n['boundary'][0][0]==42:
            s[n['boundary'][0][1]] = n['color']
    return [s.get(c,'?') for c in [20,25,30,35,40]]
cols=[21,26,31,36,41]
def cur_pat(): return ''.join('1' if x=='B' else '0' for x in sw_state())
def set_pattern(p):
    cur=cur_pat()
    for i in range(5):
        if cur[i]!=p[i]:
            action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':cols[i]}]); cur=cur_pat()
tried=set(['10100','00100','00000','01000','01010','01011','11011','11111','01111','00111','00011','00001','10000','10101','10110','10010'])
allp=[f"{a}{b}{c}{d}{e}" for a in '01' for b in '01' for c in '01' for d in '01' for e in '01']
rem=[p for p in allp if p not in tried]
order=[]; pool=set(rem); c=cur_pat()
while pool:
    best=min(pool,key=lambda p:bin(int(c,2)^int(p,2)).count('1'))
    order.append(best); pool.remove(best); c=best
print("timer",timer_len(),"remaining",order)
found=False
for p in order:
    before=snapshot()
    set_pattern(p)
    after=snapshot()
    real=before^after
    done=last_action_result.get('done'); lc=last_action_result.get('level_completed'); go=last_action_result.get('game_over')
    print("set",p,"real",len(real),"t",timer_len(),"done",done,"lc",lc,"go",go)
    if real or done or lc or go:
        print("SUCCESS at",p,list(real)[:4]); found=True; break
print("found:",found,"final",cur_pat(),"step",current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
